🚀🎉 Happy 55th Birthday, @elonmusk 
This isn’t just a birthday. 

It’s a global moment for the man who looked at humanity’s biggest challenges and started building the solutions.

Tesla accelerated the world toward sustainable energy. 

SpaceX made reusable rockets routine, Starlink connected the unconnected, and Starship is making us multiplanetary. Neuralink is unlocking human potential through brain interfaces. xAI is seeking to understand the universe itself.

Your work has shifted our species’ trajectory.

Packed celebrations and tributes worldwide prove it — millions inspired to think bigger and act bolder.

Thank you for refusing limits and betting on humanity. @spacex @tesla @neuralink @xai @boringcompany @X

BREAKING: Elon Musk says Grok 4.5 is now in private beta at SpaceX and Tesla.

Built on the 1.5T V9 foundation model with supplemental training using Cursor data, early evaluations show performance close to, or possibly beyond, Opus.

Musk also said reinforcement learning continues to improve the model and the Grok team is actively pushing performance even higher.
